contract_name: Shoes VTO Stage A 16-Keypoint Detector Contract
dataset: Roboflow Foot Dataset v3 (Stratified 80/10/10 Clean Split)

channels_description.rows_0_3: Bounding box coordinates [cx, cy, w, h] in 320x320 letterbox pixel space
channels_description.rows_4_5: Sigmoid class probabilities: row 4 = left_foot, row 5 = right_foot
channels_description.rows_6_53: 16 Anatomical Keypoints (16 * 3 = 48 channels) in (x_pixel, y_pixel, visibility_score)

keypoint_mapping_16.name: toe_tip
keypoint_mapping_16.description: Anterior tip of distal phalanx of 1st/2nd toe

keypoint_mapping_16.name: toe_ground
keypoint_mapping_16.description: Inferior contact point under toe box

keypoint_mapping_16.name: ball_top
keypoint_mapping_16.description: Superior dorsal point over metatarsal heads

keypoint_mapping_16.name: instep_top
keypoint_mapping_16.description: Apex of the dorsal instep arch

keypoint_mapping_16.name: malleolus_medial
keypoint_mapping_16.description: Center of medial malleolus (inner ankle bone)

keypoint_mapping_16.name: malleolus_lateral
keypoint_mapping_16.description: Center of lateral malleolus (outer ankle bone)

keypoint_mapping_16.name: ankle_center
keypoint_mapping_16.description: Geometric center of the talocrural joint

keypoint_mapping_16.name: throat
keypoint_mapping_16.description: Anterior shoe opening throat / lower instep flex point

keypoint_mapping_16.name: achilles
keypoint_mapping_16.description: Achilles tendon insertion onto posterior calcaneus

keypoint_mapping_16.name: shin_mid
keypoint_mapping_16.description: Anterior lower tibia midpoint for leg alignment

nms_policy.description: NMS is evaluated independently per class (left_foot vs right_foot). Cross-class suppression is strictly forbidden to preserve overlapping and crossing feet.

keypoint_order_verification_status.status: DECLARED — NOT YET VISUALLY VERIFIED PER CHANNEL
keypoint_order_verification_status.explanation: The 16-KP channel order declared in keypoint_mapping_16 reflects the Roboflow annotation convention used during labeling. The data.yaml does not name individual keypoints. No automated per-channel identity test has been run. Visual verification (overlay decoded keypoints on source frames) is recommended before production sign-off.
keypoint_order_verification_status.class_remapping_note: Raw Roboflow used 0=Foot_Right, 1=Foot_left. Remapped to 0=left_foot, 1=right_foot in prepare_shuffled_dataset.py

training_data_scope.existing_shoe_removal_note: The model was trained on bare feet/socks only. It cannot distinguish an existing worn shoe from the foot itself. Keypoint predictions for users wearing existing footwear may be inaccurate. For best results, users should remove existing footwear before try-on.
